keyPoints.en: Nationalism is a deep love for one's nation and homeland, and the struggle to free it from foreign rule and develop it.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme ialah perasaan cinta yang mendalam terhadap bangsa dan tanah air, serta perjuangan membebaskannya daripada penjajahan dan memajukannya.

keyPoints.en: The textbook gives views of Hans Kohn, William R. Roff, Dato' Onn Jaafar, Dr Burhanuddin al-Helmy, Dr R. Suntharalingam, Prof. Zainal Abidin Abdul Wahid and Prof. Khoo Kay Kim.
keyPoints.bm: Buku teks memberikan pandangan Hans Kohn, William R. Roff, Dato' Onn Jaafar, Dr Burhanuddin al-Helmy, Dr R. Suntharalingam, Prof. Zainal Abidin Abdul Wahid dan Prof. Khoo Kay Kim.

keyPoints.en: Hans Kohn described nationalism as a state of mind in which a person's highest loyalty is to the nation-state.
keyPoints.bm: Hans Kohn menyifatkan nasionalisme sebagai satu keadaan fikiran apabila kesetiaan tertinggi seseorang adalah kepada negara bangsa.

meaning.en: Love of nation and homeland, and the effort to free and develop it.
meaning.bm: Cinta akan bangsa dan tanah air, serta usaha membebaskan dan memajukannya.

meaning.en: Love and loyalty to one's country, shown by willingness to defend it.
meaning.bm: Cinta dan taat kepada negara, ditunjukkan dengan kesanggupan mempertahankannya.

meaning.en: Rule of one country over another, usually to take its wealth.
meaning.bm: Penguasaan sebuah negara ke atas negara lain, biasanya untuk mengaut kekayaannya.

points.en: Loyalty to one's own nation above other loyalties.
points.bm: Kesetiaan kepada bangsa sendiri mengatasi kesetiaan lain.

points.en: Wanting freedom from colonial rule.
points.bm: Keinginan bebas daripada penjajahan.

points.en: Pride in one's language, culture and history.
points.bm: Bangga akan bahasa, budaya dan sejarah sendiri.

points.en: Effort to make the nation advanced and respected.
points.bm: Usaha menjadikan bangsa maju dan dihormati.

answer.en: A feeling of love for one's nation and homeland that drives people to free it from colonial rule and develop it.
answer.bm: Perasaan cinta akan bangsa dan tanah air yang mendorong usaha membebaskannya daripada penjajahan dan memajukannya.

tip.en: You don't need word-for-word quotes — give the key idea and name the figure.
tip.bm: Anda tidak perlu menghafal petikan — berikan idea utama dan nama tokohnya.

keyPoints.en: Ideas of nationalism first grew in the West through three revolutions.
keyPoints.bm: Idea nasionalisme mula berkembang di Barat melalui tiga revolusi.

keyPoints.en: Glorious Revolution, England (1688): parliament became more powerful than the king.
keyPoints.bm: Revolusi Keagungan, England (1688): parlimen menjadi lebih berkuasa daripada raja.

keyPoints.en: American Revolution (1776): 13 colonies declared independence from Britain.
keyPoints.bm: Revolusi Amerika (1776): 13 tanah jajahan mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan daripada British.

keyPoints.en: French Revolution (1789): ended absolute monarchy; slogan "liberty, equality, fraternity".
keyPoints.bm: Revolusi Perancis (1789): menamatkan pemerintahan raja mutlak; slogan "kebebasan, kesamarataan, persaudaraan".

meaning.en: A king with unlimited power, not checked by a parliament or constitution.
meaning.bm: Raja yang berkuasa tanpa had, tidak dikawal parlimen atau perlembagaan.

meaning.en: English law after the Glorious Revolution limiting royal power.
meaning.bm: Undang-undang England selepas Revolusi Keagungan yang mengehadkan kuasa raja.

meaning.en: American document of 4 July 1776, mainly written by Thomas Jefferson.
meaning.bm: Dokumen Amerika pada 4 Julai 1776, kebanyakannya ditulis oleh Thomas Jefferson.

meaning.en: Liberty, equality, fraternity — the French Revolution's slogan.
meaning.bm: Kebebasan, kesamarataan, persaudaraan — slogan Revolusi Perancis.

points.en: King James II was removed without major bloodshed; William III and Mary II took the throne.
points.bm: Raja James II disingkirkan tanpa pertumpahan darah besar; William III dan Mary II menaiki takhta.

points.en: The Bill of Rights (1689) meant the king could not make laws or raise taxes without parliament.
points.bm: Bill of Rights (1689) menetapkan raja tidak boleh membuat undang-undang atau mengenakan cukai tanpa parlimen.

points.en: The colonies objected to British taxes without representation ("no taxation without representation").
points.bm: Tanah jajahan membantah cukai British tanpa perwakilan ("tiada cukai tanpa perwakilan").

points.en: Declaration of Independence on 4 July 1776; George Washington led the army; the USA was born.
points.bm: Perisytiharan Kemerdekaan pada 4 Julai 1776; George Washington memimpin tentera; Amerika Syarikat terbentuk.

points.en: Causes: absolute rule of Louis XVI, heavy taxes on ordinary people, unfair social classes.
points.bm: Punca: pemerintahan mutlak Louis XVI, cukai berat ke atas rakyat biasa, kelas sosial yang tidak adil.

points.en: 14 July 1789: the people stormed the Bastille prison.
points.bm: 14 Julai 1789: rakyat menyerbu penjara Bastille.

points.en: The Declaration of the Rights of Man spread ideas of rights and equality across Europe and beyond.
points.bm: Perisytiharan Hak Asasi Manusia menyebarkan idea hak dan kesamarataan ke seluruh Eropah dan dunia.

event.en: Storming of the Bastille (14 July) — French Revolution.

question.en: How did the French Revolution influence nationalism in other countries?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah Revolusi Perancis mempengaruhi nasionalisme di negara lain?

answer.en: Its ideas of liberty, equality and fraternity and the rights of the people spread widely, inspiring colonised peoples to demand freedom and fair government.
answer.bm: Idea kebebasan, kesamarataan dan persaudaraan serta hak rakyat tersebar luas, lalu memberi inspirasi kepada rakyat terjajah untuk menuntut kebebasan dan pemerintahan yang adil.

tip.en: Remember the years in order: 1688 → 1776 → 1789 (England → America → France).
tip.bm: Ingat tahun mengikut urutan: 1688 → 1776 → 1789 (England → Amerika → Perancis).

keyPoints.en: Nationalism in Asia rose against Western imperialism and to modernise Asian societies.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme di Asia bangkit menentang imperialisme Barat dan untuk memodenkan masyarakat Asia.

keyPoints.en: India: Indian National Congress (1885); Mahatma Gandhi's non-violent struggle; independence 1947.
keyPoints.bm: India: Kongres Kebangsaan India (1885); perjuangan tanpa kekerasan Mahatma Gandhi; merdeka 1947.

keyPoints.en: China: Dr Sun Yat-sen's 1911 Revolution ended the Qing dynasty; Republic of China 1912.
keyPoints.bm: China: Revolusi 1911 Dr Sun Yat-sen menamatkan Dinasti Qing; Republik China 1912.

keyPoints.en: Ottoman Empire and Egypt: the Islah (reform) and Pan-Islamism movements; Turkey became a republic in 1923.
keyPoints.bm: Empayar Uthmaniyah dan Mesir: gerakan Islah dan Pan-Islamisme; Turki menjadi republik pada 1923.

keyPoints.en: Japan: the Meiji Restoration (1868) modernised Japan, which defeated Russia in 1905.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun: Pemulihan Meiji (1868) memodenkan Jepun, yang mengalahkan Rusia pada 1905.

meaning.en: Gandhi's non-violent resistance ("holding to truth").
meaning.bm: Penentangan tanpa kekerasan Gandhi ("berpegang pada kebenaran").

term.bm: Tiga Prinsip Rakyat (San Min Chu I)

meaning.en: Sun Yat-sen's ideas: nationalism, democracy and people's livelihood.
meaning.bm: Idea Sun Yat-sen: nasionalisme, demokrasi dan kesejahteraan rakyat.

meaning.en: Islamic reform movement to free Muslims from backwardness by returning to the Quran and Sunnah.
meaning.bm: Gerakan pembaharuan Islam untuk membebaskan umat Islam daripada kemunduran dengan kembali kepada al-Quran dan Sunnah.

meaning.en: Idea of uniting Muslims worldwide against Western domination (Jamaluddin al-Afghani).
meaning.bm: Idea menyatukan umat Islam sedunia menentang penguasaan Barat (Jamaluddin al-Afghani).

meaning.en: From 1868, Japan modernised its government, army, industry and education.
meaning.bm: Mulai 1868, Jepun memodenkan kerajaan, tentera, industri dan pendidikannya.

points.en: Indian National Congress founded 1885; early leaders sought more rights under British rule.
points.bm: Kongres Kebangsaan India ditubuhkan 1885; pemimpin awal menuntut lebih banyak hak di bawah British.

points.en: Gandhi led mass non-violent campaigns — non-cooperation and the Salt March (1930).
points.bm: Gandhi memimpin kempen besar-besaran tanpa kekerasan — tidak bekerjasama dan Perarakan Garam (1930).

points.en: India gained independence on 15 August 1947.
points.bm: India merdeka pada 15 Ogos 1947.

points.en: Anger at the weak Qing government and foreign control after the Opium Wars.
points.bm: Kemarahan terhadap kerajaan Qing yang lemah dan kawalan asing selepas Perang Candu.

points.en: Sun Yat-sen formed the Tongmenghui (1905); the 1911 Revolution created a republic in 1912.
points.bm: Sun Yat-sen menubuhkan Tongmenghui (1905); Revolusi 1911 membentuk republik pada 1912.

points.en: Reformers Jamaluddin al-Afghani, Muhammad Abduh and Rashid Rida called for Muslims to modernise through education and reform.
points.bm: Tokoh pembaharuan Jamaluddin al-Afghani, Muhammad Abduh dan Rashid Rida menyeru umat Islam memodenkan diri melalui pendidikan dan pembaharuan.

points.en: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk founded the Republic of Turkey in 1923 and modernised it.
points.bm: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk mengasaskan Republik Turki pada 1923 dan memodenkannya.

points.en: Rashid Rida's journal al-Manar influenced Malay reformers (Kaum Muda).
points.bm: Majalah al-Manar oleh Rashid Rida mempengaruhi golongan pembaharuan Melayu (Kaum Muda).

points.en: The Meiji Restoration (1868) made Japan a modern industrial and military power.
points.bm: Pemulihan Meiji (1868) menjadikan Jepun kuasa perindustrian dan ketenteraan moden.

points.en: Japan's victory over Russia (1904–1905) proved an Asian nation could defeat a Western power.
points.bm: Kemenangan Jepun ke atas Rusia (1904–1905) membuktikan negara Asia boleh mengalahkan kuasa Barat.

question.en: Why did Japan's victory over Russia in 1905 inspire nationalists in Asia?
question.bm: Mengapakah kemenangan Jepun ke atas Rusia pada 1905 memberi inspirasi kepada nasionalis di Asia?

answer.en: It showed that Asians were not weaker than Europeans; a modernised Asian country could defeat a Western power, so others believed they too could be free.
answer.bm: Ia membuktikan orang Asia tidak lebih lemah daripada orang Eropah; negara Asia yang moden mampu mengalahkan kuasa Barat, maka bangsa lain yakin mereka juga boleh bebas.

tip.en: Make a table: country — leader/movement — method — result. It answers most comparison questions.
tip.bm: Buat jadual: negara — tokoh/gerakan — kaedah — hasil. Ia menjawab kebanyakan soalan perbandingan.

keyPoints.en: Nationalism in Southeast Asia grew against colonial rule in the Philippines, Burma, Vietnam and Indonesia, and as political reform in Thailand.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme di Asia Tenggara bangkit menentang penjajahan di Filipina, Burma, Vietnam dan Indonesia, serta sebagai pembaharuan politik di Thailand.

keyPoints.en: Philippines: José Rizal and the Katipunan; independence declared 1898.
keyPoints.bm: Filipina: José Rizal dan Katipunan; kemerdekaan diisytiharkan 1898.

keyPoints.en: Burma: Young Men's Buddhist Association (1906) and the Thakin movement (Aung San).
keyPoints.bm: Burma: Persatuan Belia Buddha (YMBA, 1906) dan gerakan Thakin (Aung San).

keyPoints.en: Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh and the Viet Minh declared independence on 2 September 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh dan Viet Minh mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan pada 2 September 1945.

keyPoints.en: Indonesia: Budi Utomo (1908), Sarekat Islam (1912), PNI (1927, Sukarno); independence proclaimed 17 August 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Indonesia: Budi Utomo (1908), Sarekat Islam (1912), PNI (1927, Sukarno); kemerdekaan diisytiharkan 17 Ogos 1945.

keyPoints.en: Thailand was never colonised; the 1932 revolution changed absolute monarchy into constitutional monarchy.
keyPoints.bm: Thailand tidak pernah dijajah; revolusi 1932 menukar sistem raja mutlak kepada raja berperlembagaan.

meaning.en: Secret Filipino society (1892, Andres Bonifacio) that fought Spanish rule.
meaning.bm: Pertubuhan rahsia Filipina (1892, Andres Bonifacio) yang menentang Sepanyol.

meaning.en: "Master" — Burmese nationalists who used this title to say Burmans, not the British, were masters of Burma.
meaning.bm: "Tuan" — nasionalis Burma yang menggunakan gelaran ini untuk menegaskan orang Burma, bukan British, ialah tuan di negara sendiri.

meaning.en: League for the Independence of Vietnam, formed by Ho Chi Minh in 1941.
meaning.bm: Liga Kemerdekaan Vietnam, ditubuhkan oleh Ho Chi Minh pada 1941.

meaning.en: Youth Pledge (1928): one homeland, one nation, one language — Indonesia.
meaning.bm: Ikrar pemuda (1928): satu tanah air, satu bangsa, satu bahasa — Indonesia.

points.en: José Rizal's novels (Noli Me Tangere, 1887) exposed Spanish abuses; he founded La Liga Filipina (1892) and was executed in 1896.
points.bm: Novel José Rizal (Noli Me Tangere, 1887) mendedahkan penindasan Sepanyol; beliau menubuhkan La Liga Filipina (1892) dan dihukum bunuh pada 1896.

points.en: The Katipunan led an armed revolution; Emilio Aguinaldo declared independence on 12 June 1898, but the USA then took over.
points.bm: Katipunan memimpin revolusi bersenjata; Emilio Aguinaldo mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan pada 12 Jun 1898, tetapi Amerika Syarikat kemudian mengambil alih.

points.en: Started through religion: YMBA (1906), then the General Council of Burmese Associations (1920).
points.bm: Bermula melalui agama: YMBA (1906), kemudian Majlis Am Persatuan Burma (1920).

points.en: Students formed the Dobama Asiayone (Thakin) in the 1930s; Aung San led the struggle; independence 4 January 1948.
points.bm: Pelajar menubuhkan Dobama Asiayone (Thakin) pada 1930-an; Aung San memimpin perjuangan; merdeka 4 Januari 1948.

points.en: Early nationalists such as Phan Boi Chau opposed French rule.
points.bm: Nasionalis awal seperti Phan Boi Chau menentang penjajahan Perancis.

points.en: Ho Chi Minh formed the Viet Minh (1941) and declared independence on 2 September 1945.
points.bm: Ho Chi Minh menubuhkan Viet Minh (1941) dan mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan pada 2 September 1945.

points.en: Budi Utomo (1908) promoted education; Sarekat Islam (1912) defended Muslim traders.
points.bm: Budi Utomo (1908) memajukan pendidikan; Sarekat Islam (1912) membela pedagang Islam.

points.en: Sukarno's PNI (1927) demanded full independence; the Sumpah Pemuda (1928) united the youth.
points.bm: PNI Sukarno (1927) menuntut kemerdekaan penuh; Sumpah Pemuda (1928) menyatukan belia.

points.en: Sukarno and Hatta proclaimed independence on 17 August 1945.
points.bm: Sukarno dan Hatta mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan pada 17 Ogos 1945.

points.en: Kings Mongkut and Chulalongkorn modernised Siam and kept it free by balancing Britain and France.
points.bm: Raja Mongkut dan Chulalongkorn memodenkan Siam dan mengekalkan kebebasannya dengan mengimbangi British dan Perancis.

points.en: The People's Party (Pridi Banomyong and others) led the 1932 revolution → constitutional monarchy; Siam was renamed Thailand in 1939.
points.bm: Parti Rakyat (Pridi Banomyong dan lain-lain) memimpin revolusi 1932 → raja berperlembagaan; Siam ditukar nama kepada Thailand pada 1939.

event.en: Indonesia (17 Aug) and Vietnam (2 Sep) declare independence.
event.bm: Indonesia (17 Ogos) dan Vietnam (2 Sep) mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan.

question.en: How was nationalism in Thailand different from the rest of Southeast Asia?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah nasionalisme di Thailand berbeza daripada negara lain di Asia Tenggara?

answer.en: Thailand was never colonised, so its nationalism aimed at political change at home — ending absolute monarchy in 1932 — rather than fighting a colonial power.
answer.bm: Thailand tidak pernah dijajah, maka nasionalismenya bertujuan mengubah politik dalam negeri — menamatkan raja mutlak pada 1932 — bukan menentang kuasa penjajah.

tip.en: Indonesian nationalism influenced Malay radicals such as the KMM — a good link to Chapter 2.7.
tip.bm: Nasionalisme Indonesia mempengaruhi golongan radikal Melayu seperti KMM — kaitan baik dengan Bab 2.7.

keyPoints.en: Nationalism in our country grew in the early 20th century as people reacted to British rule.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme di negara kita berkembang pada awal abad ke-20 sebagai reaksi terhadap pemerintahan British.

keyPoints.en: Earlier armed resistance (e.g. Naning, Perak, Pahang, Kelantan, Terengganu, Sarawak, Sabah) showed an early anti-colonial spirit.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan bersenjata terdahulu (cth. Naning, Perak, Pahang, Kelantan, Terengganu, Sarawak, Sabah) menunjukkan semangat awal menentang penjajah.

keyPoints.en: Later, people used education, writing and associations instead of weapons.
keyPoints.bm: Kemudian, rakyat menggunakan pendidikan, penulisan dan persatuan, bukan senjata.

keyPoints.en: The Malays worried about falling behind in economy and education and about the growing number of immigrants.
keyPoints.bm: Orang Melayu bimbang ketinggalan dalam ekonomi dan pendidikan serta bertambahnya bilangan imigran.

meaning.en: Opposing rule by a foreign power.
meaning.bm: Menentang pemerintahan kuasa asing.

meaning.en: Understanding one's rights and wanting a say in how the country is run.
meaning.bm: Memahami hak sendiri dan mahu bersuara dalam pemerintahan negara.

points.en: British rule reduced the power of the Malay rulers and chiefs.
points.bm: Pemerintahan British mengurangkan kuasa raja dan pembesar Melayu.

points.en: The economy was dominated by Western companies and immigrant labour; most Malays stayed in farming.
points.bm: Ekonomi dikuasai syarikat Barat dan buruh imigran; kebanyakan orang Melayu kekal bertani.

points.en: Ideas from the Middle East, Turkey, India and Indonesia reached Malay students and readers.
points.bm: Idea dari Asia Barat, Turki, India dan Indonesia sampai kepada pelajar dan pembaca Melayu.

points.en: Early resistance was local and led by chiefs to defend their power and their people.
points.bm: Penentangan awal bersifat setempat dan dipimpin pembesar untuk mempertahankan kuasa dan rakyat.

points.en: 20th-century nationalism was wider: it aimed to unite the people and eventually to win independence.
points.bm: Nasionalisme abad ke-20 lebih luas: bertujuan menyatukan rakyat dan akhirnya mencapai kemerdekaan.

question.en: Compare early local resistance with the nationalist movement of the 20th century.
question.bm: Bandingkan penentangan awal masyarakat tempatan dengan gerakan nasionalisme abad ke-20.

answer.en: Early resistance was armed, local and led by chiefs; later nationalism used education, the press and associations, involved a wider public and aimed at the whole country's freedom.
answer.bm: Penentangan awal bersenjata, setempat dan dipimpin pembesar; nasionalisme kemudian menggunakan pendidikan, akhbar dan persatuan, melibatkan rakyat yang lebih ramai dan bertujuan membebaskan seluruh negara.

keyPoints.en: Six factors gave rise to the nationalist movement: religion, creative writing, the print media, the education system, the rise of intellectuals, and outside and regional influences.
keyPoints.bm: Enam faktor kemunculan gerakan nasionalisme: peranan agama, penulisan kreatif, media cetak, sistem pendidikan, kemunculan golongan intelektual, serta pengaruh luar dan serantau.

meaning.en: Reform-minded religious scholars educated in the Middle East who urged Malays to progress.
meaning.bm: Golongan ulama berfikiran pembaharuan berpendidikan Asia Barat yang menyeru orang Melayu maju.

meaning.en: Traditional religious scholars who opposed many Kaum Muda ideas.
meaning.bm: Golongan ulama tradisional yang menentang banyak idea Kaum Muda.

meaning.en: Reformist magazine in Singapore — the first to spread Islah ideas in the Malay world.
meaning.bm: Majalah pembaharuan di Singapura — yang pertama menyebarkan idea Islah di Alam Melayu.

meaning.en: Sultan Idris Training College, Tanjung Malim — trained Malay teachers and became a centre of Malay nationalism.
meaning.bm: Maktab Perguruan Sultan Idris, Tanjung Malim — melatih guru Melayu dan menjadi pusat nasionalisme Melayu.

points.en: Kaum Muda scholars (e.g. Syed Sheikh al-Hadi, Syeikh Tahir Jalaluddin) urged Malays to leave backward practices and seek knowledge.
points.bm: Ulama Kaum Muda (cth. Syed Sheikh al-Hadi, Syeikh Tahir Jalaluddin) menyeru orang Melayu meninggalkan amalan mundur dan menuntut ilmu.

points.en: Modern madrasahs such as Madrasah al-Masyhur (Penang, 1916) taught religious and modern subjects.
points.bm: Madrasah moden seperti Madrasah al-Masyhur (Pulau Pinang, 1916) mengajar mata pelajaran agama dan moden.

points.en: Novels and poems criticised colonial rule and social problems, e.g. Hikayat Faridah Hanum (Syed Sheikh al-Hadi) and Putera Gunung Tahan (Ishak Haji Muhammad, 1937).
points.bm: Novel dan puisi mengkritik penjajahan dan masalah sosial, cth. Hikayat Faridah Hanum (Syed Sheikh al-Hadi) dan Putera Gunung Tahan (Ishak Haji Muhammad, 1937).

points.en: Newspapers and magazines spread ideas quickly: Jawi Peranakan (1876, first Malay newspaper), Al-Imam (1906), Majlis (1931), Utusan Melayu (1939).
points.bm: Akhbar dan majalah menyebarkan idea dengan cepat: Jawi Peranakan (1876, akhbar Melayu pertama), Al-Imam (1906), Majlis (1931), Utusan Melayu (1939).

points.en: SITC (1922) produced teachers who spread nationalism to villages; the Malay College Kuala Kangsar (1905) trained Malay administrators.
points.bm: MPSI (1922) melahirkan guru yang menyebarkan nasionalisme ke kampung; Kolej Melayu Kuala Kangsar (1905) melatih pentadbir Melayu.

points.en: Educated Malays — religious, English-educated and Malay-educated — led the awakening.
points.bm: Orang Melayu terpelajar — berpendidikan agama, Inggeris dan Melayu — memimpin kebangkitan.

points.en: Islah ideas from Egypt, Turkey's modernisation, Japan's 1905 victory and Indonesian nationalism all inspired local leaders.
points.bm: Idea Islah dari Mesir, pemodenan Turki, kemenangan Jepun 1905 dan nasionalisme Indonesia memberi inspirasi kepada pemimpin tempatan.

question.en: Explain how the print media helped nationalism grow.
question.bm: Jelaskan bagaimana media cetak membantu perkembangan nasionalisme.

answer.en: Newspapers like Al-Imam and Utusan Melayu spread new ideas widely, criticised colonial policies and the Malays' weak position, and raised political awareness among readers.
answer.bm: Akhbar seperti Al-Imam dan Utusan Melayu menyebarkan idea baharu secara meluas, mengkritik dasar penjajah dan kedudukan lemah orang Melayu, serta meningkatkan kesedaran politik pembaca.

tip.en: Six factors: A-P-M-P-I-P — Agama, Penulisan kreatif, Media cetak, Pendidikan, Intelektual, Pengaruh luar.
tip.bm: Enam faktor: A-P-M-P-I-P — Agama, Penulisan kreatif, Media cetak, Pendidikan, Intelektual, Pengaruh luar.

keyPoints.en: Nationalism developed through three paths: intellectuals, writing and associations.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme berkembang melalui tiga saluran: golongan intelektual, penulisan dan persatuan.

keyPoints.en: Religious, English-educated and Malay-educated intellectuals each played a role.
keyPoints.bm: Golongan intelektual berpendidikan agama, Inggeris dan Melayu masing-masing memainkan peranan.

keyPoints.en: Key associations: Kesatuan Melayu Singapura (1926), Persaudaraan Sahabat Pena (1934) and Kesatuan Melayu Muda (1938).
keyPoints.bm: Persatuan utama: Kesatuan Melayu Singapura (1926), Persaudaraan Sahabat Pena (1934) dan Kesatuan Melayu Muda (1938).

meaning.en: Kesatuan Melayu Singapura (1926), led by Mohd Eunos Abdullah — the first Malay political association.
meaning.bm: Kesatuan Melayu Singapura (1926), dipimpin Mohd Eunos Abdullah — persatuan politik Melayu yang pertama.

meaning.en: Persaudaraan Sahabat Pena Malaya (1934) — linked Malays across states through letters.
meaning.bm: Persaudaraan Sahabat Pena Malaya (1934) — menghubungkan orang Melayu merentas negeri melalui surat.

meaning.en: Kesatuan Melayu Muda (1938), led by Ibrahim Yaacob — radical, anti-colonial, aimed for independence.
meaning.bm: Kesatuan Melayu Muda (1938), dipimpin Ibrahim Yaacob — radikal, anti-penjajah, bermatlamat kemerdekaan.

meaning.en: Meetings of state Malay associations in 1939 (Kuala Lumpur) and 1940 (Singapore) to unite the Malays.
meaning.bm: Perhimpunan persatuan Melayu negeri pada 1939 (Kuala Lumpur) dan 1940 (Singapura) untuk menyatukan orang Melayu.

points.en: Religious-educated: Syed Sheikh al-Hadi, Syeikh Tahir Jalaluddin and Haji Abbas Mohd Taha founded Al-Imam (1906).
points.bm: Berpendidikan agama: Syed Sheikh al-Hadi, Syeikh Tahir Jalaluddin dan Haji Abbas Mohd Taha mengasaskan Al-Imam (1906).

points.en: English-educated: aristocrats and officials such as Mohd Eunos Abdullah worked through KMS and state associations, mostly cooperating with the British.
points.bm: Berpendidikan Inggeris: golongan bangsawan dan pegawai seperti Mohd Eunos Abdullah bergerak melalui KMS dan persatuan negeri, kebanyakannya bekerjasama dengan British.

points.en: Malay-educated: SITC graduates and writers such as Ibrahim Yaacob and Ishak Haji Muhammad were more radical.
points.bm: Berpendidikan Melayu: lulusan MPSI dan penulis seperti Ibrahim Yaacob dan Ishak Haji Muhammad lebih radikal.

points.en: Malay newspapers and magazines: Al-Imam, Saudara, Majlis, Warta Malaya, Utusan Melayu (1939, Yusof Ishak and Abdul Rahim Kajai).
points.bm: Akhbar dan majalah Melayu: Al-Imam, Saudara, Majlis, Warta Malaya, Utusan Melayu (1939, Yusof Ishak dan Abdul Rahim Kajai).

points.en: Chinese and Indian newspapers (e.g. Nanyang Siang Pau, Tamil Nesan) mostly followed politics in China and India.
points.bm: Akhbar Cina dan India (cth. Nanyang Siang Pau, Tamil Nesan) kebanyakannya mengikuti politik di China dan India.

points.en: Creative works: novels, short stories and poems that criticised society and colonialism.
points.bm: Karya kreatif: novel, cerpen dan sajak yang mengkritik masyarakat dan penjajahan.

points.en: KMS (1926): won seats for Malays in Singapore and a Malay settlement (Kampung Melayu, Singapore).
points.bm: KMS (1926): mendapatkan perwakilan Melayu di Singapura dan kawasan penempatan Melayu (Kampung Melayu, Singapura).

points.en: State Malay associations (e.g. Perak 1937, Selangor and Pahang 1938) met at the Malay Associations Congress in 1939 and 1940.
points.bm: Persatuan Melayu negeri (cth. Perak 1937, Selangor dan Pahang 1938) bertemu dalam Kongres Persatuan Melayu pada 1939 dan 1940.

points.en: KMM (1938) openly opposed colonialism and was influenced by Indonesian nationalism.
points.bm: KMM (1938) secara terbuka menentang penjajahan dan dipengaruhi nasionalisme Indonesia.

points.en: Chinese and Indian associations, e.g. Kuomintang branches and the Central Indian Association of Malaya (1936), focused on homeland issues and their community's rights.
points.bm: Persatuan Cina dan India, cth. cawangan Kuomintang dan Persatuan Pusat India Malaya (1936), menumpukan isu tanah air asal dan hak komuniti mereka.

event.en: Utusan Melayu; first Malay Associations Congress.
event.bm: Utusan Melayu; Kongres Persatuan Melayu pertama.

question.en: Compare the aims of KMS and KMM.

answer.en: KMS (moderate, English-educated) cooperated with the British to improve the Malays' position; KMM (radical, Malay-educated) opposed colonial rule and wanted independence.
answer.bm: KMS (sederhana, berpendidikan Inggeris) bekerjasama dengan British untuk memperbaiki kedudukan orang Melayu; KMM (radikal, berpendidikan Melayu) menentang penjajahan dan mahukan kemerdekaan.

tip.en: Sort leaders by education type — examiners like "golongan intelektual agama / Inggeris / Melayu".
tip.bm: Susun tokoh mengikut jenis pendidikan — pemeriksa suka "golongan intelektual agama / Inggeris / Melayu".

keyPoints.en: The nationalist movement had political, economic and social effects.
keyPoints.bm: Gerakan nasionalisme memberi kesan politik, ekonomi dan sosial.

keyPoints.en: Political: wider political awareness and the base for later parties such as UMNO and the struggle for independence.
keyPoints.bm: Politik: kesedaran politik meluas dan menjadi asas kepada parti seperti UMNO dan perjuangan kemerdekaan.

keyPoints.en: Economic: Malays became aware of their weak economic position and were urged to enter business.
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi: orang Melayu sedar akan kedudukan ekonomi yang lemah dan digesa menceburi perniagaan.

keyPoints.en: Social: more emphasis on education, the Malay language and literature, and the role of women.
keyPoints.bm: Sosial: penekanan lebih kepada pendidikan, bahasa dan sastera Melayu, serta peranan wanita.

meaning.en: Wanting a say in government and the country's future.
meaning.bm: Keinginan bersuara dalam pemerintahan dan masa depan negara.

meaning.en: Malays across states began to see themselves as one community.
meaning.bm: Orang Melayu merentas negeri mula melihat diri mereka sebagai satu bangsa.

points.en: Associations trained leaders who later led the anti-Malayan Union movement (1946).
points.bm: Persatuan melatih pemimpin yang kemudian memimpin penentangan Malayan Union (1946).

points.en: Writers urged Malays to save, form cooperatives and do business.
points.bm: Penulis menggesa orang Melayu berjimat, menubuhkan koperasi dan berniaga.

points.en: More Malay schools and religious schools; Malay literature flourished.
points.bm: Lebih banyak sekolah Melayu dan sekolah agama; kesusasteraan Melayu berkembang.

points.en: Women's education and roles were discussed in newspapers and magazines.
points.bm: Pendidikan dan peranan wanita dibincangkan dalam akhbar dan majalah.

question.en: State ONE political effect of the growth of nationalism in our country.
question.bm: Nyatakan SATU kesan politik perkembangan nasionalisme di negara kita.

answer.en: It raised political awareness and produced leaders and associations that later united to oppose the Malayan Union and fight for independence.
answer.bm: Ia meningkatkan kesedaran politik dan melahirkan pemimpin serta persatuan yang kemudian bersatu menentang Malayan Union dan memperjuangkan kemerdekaan.
